commands.review_summary:
The PR stores source workflow URLs on fresh apply-health snapshots, preserves retained snapshots during later status writes, makes dashboard cards prefer the nested URL with a legacy fallback, and adds regression coverage and proof images.

Reproducibility: yes. at the source level. Current main can retain an old health snapshot while replacing the root run URL, and the dashboard then projects that later URL onto the retained warning card; the production screenshot corroborates the affected surface.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] The contributor must provide real browser behavior proof and make the small test-placement cleanup; ClawSweeper should not queue a repair because automation cannot create proof from the contributor's setup.

target.title: fix(dashboard): link apply health cards to source runs
target.body:
## Summary

- Keep every apply-health dashboard alert linked to the workflow run that generated that health snapshot.
- Preserve the mutable top-level status link only as a fallback for older snapshots.
- Prevent later review/status writes from replacing a retained apply-health source link.

## Problem

The dashboard retained an apply-health warning while later review/status writes replaced the top-level `run_url`. The "Pruning sweep blocked" card therefore opened a later, unrelated review run. In the captured production case it linked to [run 29091926566](https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/actions/runs/29091926566), a successful hot-review run whose apply job was skipped.

![Before fix: dashboard alert pointing at an unrelated workflow run](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/codex/fix-apply-health-link/docs/proof/dashboard-apply-health-run-link/mislinked-apply-health-alert.png)

## After-fix behavior proof

The redacted local dashboard below is generated by `dashboard/worker.ts` from the captured production status shape: the apply warning originated in [run 29091427650](https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/actions/runs/29091427650), while a later status write pointed at [run 29091585991](https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/actions/runs/29091585991). Both rendered card links resolved to the originating apply run; browser navigation verified that destination. No live state, workflow, or deployment was changed to create this proof.

![After fix: generated dashboard card](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/codex/fix-apply-health-link/docs/proof/dashboard-apply-health-run-link/after-fix-local-dashboard.png)

## Implementation

- Stamp `run_url` into a fresh apply-health snapshot.
- Read the nested immutable health URL before the mutable root status URL.
- Retain an existing health object unchanged during non-apply status updates; only a fresh health payload gets the current run URL.
- Add regression coverage for reader precedence and writer preservation.

## Validation

- `pnpm run build:all`
- `node --test test/clawsweeper.test.ts test/dashboard-worker.test.ts` (138 passing)
- `pnpm run lint:src`
- `pnpm run lint:dashboard`
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check src/clawsweeper.ts test/clawsweeper.test.ts dashboard/worker.ts test/dashboard-worker.test.ts`
- `git diff --check`

## Review closeout

The dirty-patch Codex review for the proof/changelog follow-up was clean. The branch review then found and this update fixes a real P2: retained health had still been passed through a later status write and could be restamped with that later run URL.

After the P2 fix, two required `codex review --uncommitted` attempts stalled without a verdict (the first exceeded its full ten-minute window). The maintainer explicitly authorized publishing this update without that final Codex review while the stall is investigated. This exception is limited to this update.

## Risks and rollout

New snapshots gain a nested source URL. Existing snapshots continue using the top-level URL fallback, so the change is backward compatible. It affects dashboard observability only; sweep, comment, label, and close behavior are unchanged.

## Links

- State snapshot with the original apply run: [0557127d580c](https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper-state/commit/0557127d580c2e4a7ac6f59ea84e3c592135461e)
- Production symptom: [run 29091926566](https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/actions/runs/29091926566)
